```{r echo=FALSE}
datasets <- readRDS("datasets.rds")
```

This study has two diets (`HC_LF` = high carb, low fat; `HF_LC` = high fat, low carb) with `r length(datasets)`  measurement sets collected on 192 mice:
  
```{r echo=FALSE, comment = ""}
dataset <- dplyr::tibble(Name = names(datasets), "\ " = "  ", Description = datasets)
print(as.data.frame(dataset), right = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
